short_metadata.title: Why Big Tech is Overrated
short_metadata.description:
Alright, breaking news: 10,000 employees are now "synergy-free" as MegaCorp pivots to its next big thing. That "thing"? A revolutionary AI chatbot primarily focused on generating unrequested, utterly baffling lentil soup recipes. Because apparently, job security is just collateral damage when you're building a future where your digital assistant thinks you're hungry for pixelated minestrone. headline: A multi-billion dollar EV company recalling all cars because the touch screen won't let you roll down the windows

long_metadata.title: The Full Corporate Tech Reality Check
long_metadata.description:
Alright, gather 'round the digital water cooler.

Your multi-billion dollar EV company just issued a full recall because their "cutting-edge" touch screen can't figure out how to, you know, roll down a window. Turns out, true luxury is still having a physical button that allows you to escape your climate-controlled digital prison for a bit of actual wind. Subscribe for more corporate burns.
